text: Cycling is a sport that requires precision and control. The most common component of a cycling bicycle is the front and rear braking system. The brake pads are placed within the brake caliper, which is a small device that holds the brake pads in place. The brake pads are then pressed against the rim of the tire, applying a considerable amount of force to stop the bike. The pedals are also connected to the braking system, allowing for easy and efficient pedaling.
